appointments_operatory_no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (tenant_id WITH =, operatory_id WITH =, tstzrange(occupied_start_at, occupied_end_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE (((status)::text <> 'cancelled'::text))
